scenes.say: Math Blitz, day four! You owned Opposite Day, so here's a brand new play: The Hand-Off! A number outside the parentheses passes to every player inside.

scenes.heading: THE HAND-OFF
scenes.note: Hand it to EVERY term inside.
scenes.say: Three times x plus four. The three hands off to every term inside. Three times x, plus three times four. That's three x plus twelve.

scenes.heading: TEAM UP THE x's
scenes.say: Two times x plus five, plus three x, equals thirty. Hand it off: two x plus ten. Team up the x's: five x plus ten.

scenes.heading: FINISH IT
scenes.say: Subtract ten: five x equals twenty. Divide by five: x equals four. Check it: two times nine plus twelve is thirty. Touchdown!

scenes.ask: What is the value of x?
scenes.say: Your turn, champ! Twenty five XP on the line. Four times x minus three, plus two x, equals eighteen. Hand it off! What is x? Tap your answer below the video!

question.prompt: 4(x − 3) + 2x = 18. What is the value of x?
question.explain: Hand off the 4: 4x − 12 + 2x = 18. Team up: 6x − 12 = 18. Add 12: 6x = 30, so x = 5. Check: 4(2) + 10 = 18.

trap_notes.2: Only handed the 4 to the x, not the −3 (6x − 3 = 18)
trap_notes.3: Stopped at 6x = 30 and forgot to divide by 6

rapid.why: Hand off the 5: 5x + 10 = 35. Subtract 10: 5x = 25, so x = 5.
The −2 hands off to both: −2x − 6 = 10 → −2x = 16 → x = −8.

rapid.prompt: Tickets cost $x each plus a $3 fee per ticket. 4 friends pay $52 in all. What is x?
rapid.why: 4(x + 3) = 52 → x + 3 = 13 → x = 10. The fee is per ticket, so it gets the hand-off too.
6x − 3 − 2x − 8 = 9 → 4x = 20 → x = 5, so 2x = 10. Answer what they asked!
